name: Almendral S.A.
summary: Almendral S.A., through its subsidiaries, provides telecommunication services in Chile and Peru. The company provides mobile telecommunications services, including voice, added value, data, broadband, mobile internet, and fixed network services, as well as call center services for the corporate market. It also offers data services; local telephony; Internet access; long-distance public telephony; information technology services, including data center, business process outsourcing, and operational continuity; digital and cybersecurity services; network leasing; and wholesale traffic businesses. The company was formerly known as Chilquinta, S.A. and changed its name to Almendral S.A. in 2001. …
